name: 共有投稿の宛先と投稿元の補足
prompt:
Make a targeted correction to the previous LH03-0206 candidate. Keep its content, semantic link colors, emoji, white background and overall two-row arrangement. Correct only typography scale and the second-row vertical position.

Use the native 390×80 preview as the exact size and spacing reference. In the previous candidate, both text rows are about 20-25% too large. Reduce the member-link text to the native Meiryo Bold 14 px / 24 px role and the metadata to Meiryo Regular 12 px / 16 px. At a 390×80 display size, the Japanese glyphs should be visibly the same compact size as the preview, not large heading text. Keep the raised-hands emoji about 24 px and leave it unchanged.

Keep the first row content exactly: the original full-color raised-hands emoji at x≈24 px, then 山田さん　佐藤さん in blue #1976D2 with no underline. Preserve the existing spacing and one-line layout.

Keep the second row content exactly 交流のアイデアに投稿・1日前. Only 交流のアイデア is a blue #1976D2 hyperlink; に投稿・1日前 remains gray #6E6E6E. Move this row up about 3 px from the previous version to align with the native preview's y≈48 px position.

Keep the pure white 390×80 canvas with no card, border, shadow, divider, avatar, buttons, toolbar, extra copy or decorative color. Use the preview for precise proportions, the previous candidate for colors and content, and the original crop for the emoji. The link-color crop and approved community example are color/style cues only; do not copy unrelated content, icons or layout. Preserve all visible product copy in Japanese.
reviewNotes: v002 final attempt visually compared at 390x80 with the native preview and source crop. Both member names and the channel link are blue #1976D2; timestamp suffix is gray; raised-hands emoji is preserved. After one correction, text remains about 10-15% wider/taller and ink sits 2-4px below native positions, though Japanese copy is exact and there is no clipping or wrapping. Mark needs-correction after two attempts. Candidate is a lossless crop [0,194,1658,534] of raw ImageGen output [private local evidence]; raw file retained.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
